chatwoot._comment: CRM 客服台（add-crm-desk-bridge）：npm dist 即上游官方 bun --target node 单文件 bundle，node 直跑零本地构建。BYOK：envRefs 只持名字，值在 patch 写入时从部署 env 解析（CHATWOOT_API_TOKEN 含 TOKEN 会被 dsh 子进程擦洗，envRefs 是合规转发通道）。requiresEnv：两值全缺的部署整体省略本条目（而非死条目）；部分缺失沿 envRefs 警告降级。工具面上界（98 标准面）见 lib/operator-tool-face.js。

websearch._comment: envRefs name (never hold) the relay env pair — dsh's subprocess scrub strips TOKEN-shaped names from MCP children, so the pair is forwarded explicitly at patch-write time. Both unset ⇒ web_search degrades to an explicit not-configured error. SEARCH_USER_KEY (add-search-byok) is the user's OWN key: optional by design — its absence is the normal state, not a degradation.
